subject: Re: Tundra status: parser trained, action-item labels are the weak spot
body:
Yara, Deshawn,

Going with the cheap option. Decisions:

1. Merge the two ambiguous action-item label pairs into coarse labels for v1. Wei, please rerun eval on the merged scheme and report the F1 — I expect it lands near 0.75, and that's the number the summarizer team actually needs.
2. No re-annotation this window. If a partner later needs the fine-grained distinction, we scope the tightened guide then, with their requirements in hand.
3. Tundra stays internal-only through the readout; nothing external without a Launch Review Board pass, and we aren't asking for one yet.

Readout July 20. Yara, nice work getting through the vocabulary blocker without losing the schedule.

Dmitri
